prepared_writes.title: [o1-windows-portability] test_blue_review_delivery_prepare.py: read_text() without encoding fails on Windows (cp932)
prepared_writes.body:
`automation/command_bus/tests/test_blue_review_delivery_prepare.py` line 277 reads .github/workflows/blue-work-reconcile-static.yml with `Path.read_text()` and no encoding. That file contains non-ASCII UTF-8 text, so on Windows (default encoding cp932) the read raises UnicodeDecodeError or decodes wrongly; on Linux it passes. The same pattern failed on Windows in PRD-002 (main 702497c); this file itself has not been run on Windows yet.

Change only: automation/command_bus/tests/test_blue_review_delivery_prepare.py. Do not weaken, skip or delete any existing test. Run the test commands before opening the pull request, and put `Fixes #<this issue>` in the pull request body.
